title: Kospet Hope 4g smartwatch does not upload data to Nightscout
body: Greeting to all members. We have recently bought the Kospet Hope 4g smartwatch with android 7.1 We have used until now other smartwatches with Android 6.0 with great success. We have nightscout and azure. The Kospet watch refused to upload any data to azure(we receive bluetooth data from our transmitter-blukon). I have checked all the battery options so no application gets to sleep neither the Wifi and the Data, and i have checked i hope all the applications permissions concerning the Xdrip. Any thoughts? Will be better to change to Heroku and see if the problem remains? I even try to set the watch as a follower but it does not show anything .
